sources.author: Karthik Ramasamy
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO at Decodable | Ex-Google, Twitter
sources.post_summary: Discussed how AI agents are shifting from chat interfaces to autonomous systems that can plan, execute, and iterate on complex developer workflows. Highlighted real examples of agents handling code reviews, infrastructure provisioning, and debugging without constant human input.

sources.author: Sarah Guo
sources.headline: Founder at Conviction | Investor & AI Thought Leader
sources.post_summary: Shared observations on the rapid evolution of AI infrastructure, noting that the bottleneck is moving from model training to reliable agent orchestration and observability. Emphasized the need for new tooling around agent memory, tool use, and failure recovery.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI Researcher & Creator of Datasette
sources.post_summary: Posted about practical automation patterns using AI agents for data pipelines and developer productivity. Included examples of agents that can generate, test, and deploy code changes while maintaining human oversight through clear checkpoints.

sources.author: Nader Dabit
sources.headline: Developer Advocate at AWS | Founder of Amplify
sources.post_summary: Explored how AI-powered developer tools are changing infrastructure management, with agents now capable of analyzing logs, suggesting optimizations, and even applying fixes in production environments under guardrails.

sources.author: Elena Voss
sources.headline: Head of Revenue Operations at Notion
sources.post_summary: Elena shared a framework for aligning GTM engineering with revenue operations by building automated lead scoring models that integrate CRM data with product usage signals. She emphasized how this approach reduced manual handoffs between sales and marketing teams by 40%.

sources.author: Marcus Hale
sources.headline: Founder & CEO at OutreachScale
sources.post_summary: Marcus discussed outbound automation strategies that combine multi-channel sequences with AI-driven personalization, highlighting a case study where his team achieved a 3x increase in reply rates while cutting manual prospecting time in half.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: Director of Content Strategy at HubSpot
sources.post_summary: Priya outlined how content strategy should be embedded into revenue operations by creating modular content assets that sales teams can dynamically assemble for different buyer personas, resulting in faster deal velocity.

sources.author: Liam Torres
sources.headline: GTM Engineer at Ramp
sources.post_summary: Liam explained building internal tooling for GTM engineering that automates pipeline hygiene and forecasting accuracy, sharing metrics showing a 25% improvement in forecast reliability after implementing the system.

sources.author: Alex Hormozi
sources.headline: Founder & Investor | Author of $100M Offers
sources.post_summary: Shared the exact playbook he used to launch and scale multiple companies, emphasizing that shipping imperfect products fast and iterating based on real user feedback beats waiting for perfection.

sources.author: Pieter Levels
sources.headline: Solo Founder | Nomad List & Remote OK
sources.post_summary: Posted about launching a new micro-SaaS in under 48 hours as a solo developer, including the tech stack, revenue numbers from the first week, and lessons on staying lean.

sources.author: Sarah Drasner
sources.headline: VP of Developer Experience | Former Netlify
sources.post_summary: Detailed her career pivot from design into engineering leadership, highlighting the skills that transferred and the deliberate projects she built to demonstrate technical credibility.

sources.author: Danny Postma
sources.headline: Founder | Headlime & 10x your content
sources.post_summary: Shared weekly updates on building and shipping new AI features, including user feedback loops, pricing experiments, and the decision to stay solo rather than raise funding.
